_comment: Session cluster centroids. One doc per HDBSCAN cluster per run plus one run_summary per run. Parallel to es-mappings/cowrie/command_clusters.json but keyed to session-level clustering. `playbook_id` (format: `sescl-<16hex>`, a SHA-256 prefix over the sorted member-session-id set — see src/enrich/sources/cowrie/sessions.py:_make_playbook_id) is the canonical playbook primary key. Content-addressed so identical membership across cluster runs yields identical ids; downstream campaign ids hash the sorted playbook-id set and therefore stabilise too. Multiple cluster docs in the same run may share one `playbook_id` if their centroids were merged at `session.playbook_merge_threshold`. `playbook_name` is a human-readable LLM-generated display label and may duplicate across playbooks. A 'playbook' is the LLM-named group of one or more session clusters — distinct from a 'campaign', which is a multi-session pattern mined into a separate index (see es-mappings/cowrie/campaigns.json). `stable_playbook_id` (format: `spb-<16hex>`) is the churn-resistant identity (ROADMAP #1): assigned by cosine-matching each run's playbook centroid to the nearest anchor (>= session.playbook_merge_threshold) and reusing its id, minting fresh only on no-match — so adding the Nth session does not flip the id. Anchors are pinned at first mint in the separate write-once `prism.identity.cowrie.playbook_anchor` index (see es-mappings/cowrie/playbook_anchors.json) and never updated, so this index's cluster-doc churn cannot move them. Written alongside `playbook_id` during the dual-write/observation phase; readers still key on `playbook_id` until the swap. `ip_specificity` / `command_specificity` (flattened {key: score} maps, ROADMAP #4) carry the per-cluster IDF-shape distinctiveness of each member IP / command (1.0 = unique to this cluster, ~0 = commodity); computed in the cluster pass (src/enrich/sources/cowrie/sessions.py:_persist_cluster_specificity) and read by the console drawer + /api/playbook/{id}/distinctive.
